remarks: Turn-key RESTAURANT BUSINESS/ASSET FOR SALE opportunity featuring a substantial existing buildout and attractive lease structure. Sale includes furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E), commercial kitchen infrastructure, dining and bar areas, allowing a new operator to step into an established restaurant environment without the significant time and expense associated with a new buildout. Well-positioned for a chef-owner, restaurant group, or experienced operator looking to introduce their own concept. Sale is for business assets and leasehold interest only; real estate is not included. Reach out to Listing Broker for additional information regarding the Business For Sale Opportunity.
